 Garo Hills get bank holiday for Wangala Festival
 by 
 HP News Service 
 November 9, 2026 
 in 
 West Garo Hills 0 Representational Image
 0 
 SHARES 4 
 VIEWS 
 Shillong, Nov 9: November 12 will be a bank holiday for all banks and financial institutions operating in the five districts of Garo Hills, it was announced today.
 The order was made by the Meghalaya Governor under the Negotiable Instruments Act 1881 on account of the Hundred Drums Wangala Festival.
 The four-day celebration begins on November 11 and is expected to bring together thousands of drummers, dancers, traditional artistes and visitors to celebrate 50 years of the iconic festival.
